summary:
In this chapter we see the first time someone chose to listen to a lie instead of listening to God. The serpent questioned what God had said and tried to make it sound like God could not be trusted. The lie sounded appealing, but it was not true. When the woman and the man chose to believe the serpent instead of God's word, everything changed.

Sin entered the world, and with it came fear, shame, and brokenness. The man and the woman hid from God because they knew they had disobeyed Him. This shows how lies work—they promise something good but lead to harm instead. Listening to voices that turn us away from God will always lead us in the wrong direction.

Even in this difficult moment, God did not abandon them. He confronted the wrong that had been done, but He also cared for them and covered them. This chapter reminds us that God's voice is the one we can trust. When we listen to Him instead of the voice of deception, we walk in the life He created us to live.
